title: A Semi-analytic Method for Rapid Coverage Analysis of a Satellite Using Piecewise Ellipse Models
summary: Satellite coverage analysis commonly relies on intensive numerical computations to evaluate access and revisit times, resulting in high computational costs, particularly in long-term performance assessment and large-scale constellation analysis involving numerous satellites. To address this issue, this paper presents a semi-analytic method for rapid coverage analysis for a satellite using piecewise ellipse models.
